## Decision

The proposed architectural decision, contract, or structural change.

## Context

The problem this solves and why the current architecture cannot express it.

## Alternatives Considered

- Alternative 1 — and why it was not chosen.
- Alternative 2 — and why it was not chosen.

## Impact

- Modules and layers affected.
- Dependencies changed (ARC-002, ADR-0002).
- Compatibility and migration impact.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] An ADR or RFC documents the decision.
- [ ] The change is consistent with the architecture and ADR-0001/ADR-0002.
